name: InertiaMC
description:
InertiaMC mixes classic LifeSteal combat with a custom generator economy. Every fight matters here because winning steals a heart directly from your opponent. If you lose all of yours, you are stuck as a ghost until your ghost timer runs out or a teammate manages to revive you.

Making money is pretty straightforward. You place item generators on your land, sell the drops in the server shop, and dump that cash back into upgrading your setup through 25 different tiers. To keep your hard work safe from raids, you can start a clan with up to four friends and claim land around your base and gens. Clans also have 50 levels to grind through alongside weekly clan challenges.

If you want PvP action, the King of the Hill arena opens four times a day. Holding the hill pays out cash, Bits, and a KOTH crate key. You can use keys to unlock crates packed with custom wands and special ability relics, or just buy and sell gear with other players on the auction house.

We also reward daily voters with a streak system that unlocks free ranks over time. When you first spawn in, a quick guided tour walks you through the basics, and typing /help covers everything else in-game (plus our staff team is always around on Discord if you get stuck).

You can join from Bedrock Edition at mps.inertiamc.net with port 19132, or on Java Edition 1.21 and newer using the IP mps.inertiamc.net.
